subject: Earth's mantle
hook: EARTH'S MANTLE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Earth's mantle is not just a uniform layer of hot rock; it contains two continent-sized anomalies deep inside that may be buried remnants of Theia, the planet-sized body that collided with early Earth to form the Moon.
angle_support: Seismic images of Earth's interior have revealed in the lowermost mantle two continent-sized anomalies with low seismic velocities.
These anomalies may represent buried relics of Theia mantle material remaining after the Moon-forming event proposed in the Giant-impact hypothesis.
title: Theia's Hidden Grave Inside Earth
description: Deep within Earth's mantle lie two continent-sized anomalies that defy standard geological expectations. These massive structures may actually be the ancient remains of Theia, the planet that crashed into Earth to form our moon.
narration: EARTH'S MANTLE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture a uniform layer of hot, flowing rock. It was closer to a chaotic graveyard. Deep inside, two continent-sized anomalies hide within the planet's dense interior. Seismic imaging reveals these massive, low-velocity zones resting near the core. Researchers suggest they are not native Earth rock. Instead, these dense blobs are likely buried remnants of Theia, the planet-sized body that collided with early Earth. The moon’s creator still haunts the center of our own world.
